_comment: Project-scoped MCP servers. Every agent that clones/references this repo inherits these after a one-time approval prompt. Requires Node.js 18+. Cross-platform: the bare-npx form below works on macOS and Linux, and on Windows in most setups. WINDOWS FALLBACK: if a server fails to launch with 'spawn npx ENOENT' (Claude Code issue #58510), change that server's "command" to "cmd" and prefix its args with "/c", "npx", e.g. { "command": "cmd", "args": ["/c", "npx", "-y", "@playwright/mcp@latest"] }. Do NOT use the cmd form on macOS/Linux (there is no 'cmd'). This backs the 'Browser automation' and 'Web scraping' rows in the skill matrix with a real tool.
